shadow.$description: Semantic shadow aliases. v0.11.13 — every accent-coloured shadow now references the spring-green {color.alpha.accent.*} primitives. Pre-v0.11.13 the focus rings, button glows, ai-shimmer, input focus + success halos all hardcoded v0.4 lime rgba(74,222,128,X) and so silently bypassed the v0.11 brand recolor. With this rewiring, any future accent retune cascades through every shadow alias automatically. Input.error references {color.alpha.danger.32} (refined v0.11 #E5484D) so the error halo inherits the danger primitive — pre-v0.11.13 it was inlined at the v0.10 #ef4444 RGB. v0.13.2 — added shadow.elevation.{sm,md,lg} as semantic aliases on top of the primitive shadow.{sm,md,lg} scale (so contracts can read 'elevation.sm' meaningfully without consuming a primitive), shadow.glow.accent as a semantic alias for shadow.accent-glow, and shadow.kbd for the keyboard-chrome subtle inset.

elevation.$description: v0.13.2 — semantic shadow elevation ladder. Wraps the primitive shadow scale with a name that consumers can reason about ('elevation.sm' = subtle lift). Consume these in component contracts rather than the primitive shadow.{sm,md,lg} directly.

sm.$description: Subtle lift. Card resting, input focus halo, slider thumb shadow.

md.$description: Standard lift. Lifted Card, BottomNav inset, sticky chrome.

lg.$description: Strong lift. Popover, dropdown menu, floating action.

glow.$description: v0.14 R11 — the glow.accent semantic alias is preserved for backwards-compat with v0.13 consumers, but its value now aliases the neutral elevation ladder (no more green shadow). Hero CTAs ride their green BACKGROUND fill as the brand mark; surrounding atmospheric green halos retired per AGENTS.md hard rule 20.

accent.$description: v0.14 R11 — was a spring-green glow; now resolves through shadow.accent-glow which itself aliases to a neutral elevation. The semantic name is preserved so component contracts don't break, but the visual is now neutral elevation.

kbd.$description: v0.13.2 — keyboard-chrome subtle inset shadow. Used by Kbd primitive to suggest a 1-pixel raised key edge without the heaviness of a full shadow.md.

card.$description: Cards default to a hairline border with this very subtle shadow. Reach for shadow.lifted only when card is genuinely lifting.

focus.$description: v0.14 R11 — focus indicator goes neutral. Was a 3 px spring-green halo at accent-32; now a 3 px theme-aware paper/ink ring at 40 % alpha (--border-frame). Per AGENTS.md hard rule 20, no shadow value carries green; the focus ring is a structural a11y indicator (WCAG 2.4.7 + 2.4.13), not a brand statement. For primary CTAs whose green BG would approach the ring color, compose shadow.focus.dual which interposes a 2 px canvas-colored separator before the 4 px neutral outer ring.

focus.dual.$description: v0.9 — Dual-ring focus indicator. Inner 2 px page-canvas-colored separator + outer 4 px neutral ring. v0.14 R11 — outer ring re-anchored from var(--lumen-accent-4) (spring green) to var(--border-frame) (40 %-alpha theme-aware neutral). Green is banished from all shadow color values; the inner separator + outer neutral ring still passes WCAG 2.4.13's 3:1 floor on every button surface.

inner.$description: Inner separator ring — paints the page canvas color, creating a 2 px gap between the button and the outer neutral ring.

outer.$description: v0.14 R11 — outer 2 px neutral ring (was lime). 40 %-alpha theme-aware paper/ink — passes 3:1 against canvas regardless of button surface.

stack.$description: v0.14 R11 — composed dual-ring (inner + outer). Apply as a single box-shadow on focus-visible. The underlying source-of-truth is color.surface.page (inner) and color.border.frame (outer).

button.$description: v0.9 — primary-button glow ladder. v0.14 R11 — the green halo retired. The token names are preserved for backwards-compat but the rest-state cast is `none`, hover gets a neutral elevation lift via shadow.md, active is `none`. Primary CTAs still carry the brand via their green BACKGROUND fill; the surrounding atmospheric green halo previously reinforced the action affordance but is banished per the user's no-green-shadows mandate (AGENTS.md hard rule 20).

rest.$description: v0.14 R11 — was 16px @ accent-25; now `none`. The green button background is the brand affordance at rest; the surrounding halo retired.

hover.$description: v0.14 R11 — was 20px @ accent-28; now aliases the neutral shadow.md lift. The hover affordance is a neutral elevation, not a green glow.

active.$description: v0.14 R11 — was 8px @ accent-20; now `none`. Active state carries via filter: brightness(0.92), not via shadow.

ai-shimmer.$description: v0.14 R11 — AI-action shimmer border is now neutral (was accent-32). Animation cycles between border-frame (rest), border-strong (peak), with a neutral paper-alpha halo at the peak. See globals.css `@keyframes lumen-btn-ai-shimmer`.

input.$description: v0.6 — input field shell shadows. Composed: lit-edge (rest) + focus/error halo (active state). Apply to .lumen-field wrapper, never to the inner <input>. v0.11.13 — focus + success refs to spring-green primitives, error refs to refined v0.11 danger primitive.

lit-edge.$description: 1px lit top edge — steals the glass-pane reflection trick from glassmorphism without committing to full glass. Dark mode only; no-op on light. v0.11.13 — references color.alpha.paper.06.

focus.$description: v0.14 R11 — focus halo on .lumen-field wrapper is neutral (was accent-32). border-frame is 40 %-alpha theme-aware; passes WCAG 2.4.13 on every surface. Inputs no longer signal focus via the accent — they signal it via the same neutral halo every other interactive element uses.

error.$description: v0.6 — error halo. Painted on focus when [data-invalid=true]; replaces (not stacks with) shadow.input.focus. Error keeps red because red is a validation tone, distinct from action/brand — and per AGENTS.md hard rule 20 the no-green-in-shadows mandate is specifically about GREEN, not all colored shadows. Red/amber validation halos remain encoded.

success.$description: v0.14 R11 — success halo is neutral (was accent-32). The post-validation success affordance is now communicated via a brief check icon + the field returning to default border — not via a green halo. See micro-interactions.md §Success.
